name: synthesis-window-upper
description: The synthesis window at code 2 (108 B), the format's strongest point against size-matched WebP. Split from synthesis-window.json rather than added as extra arms because guards, the dE00 delta and the paired CI are all computed against the FIRST row: mixing tiers in one config would compare a 108-byte arm to a 32-byte incumbent and make the tightest instrument in the harness meaningless. Same pattern as scalefactor-bands / scalefactor-bands-t1. This is the tier where a regression costs the most -- README.md 14.1 rests the format's positioning claim on it -- and, per EXPERIMENTS.md 7.14, ringing climbs monotonically with tier while every fidelity metric improves, so it is also where the window has the most to suppress. Every arm pins all four window knobs explicitly, including the incumbent: a `tune` string is applied on top of `Tunables::DEFAULT`, so an omitted knob inherits whatever ships, and an arm labelled "no window" or "luma only" would stop being either the moment a window became the default. That is the defect EXPERIMENTS.md 9.5 records for seven other configs, which is reason enough not to seed it in two more.
